text: 冰冷光束造成的伤害没有你担心的那么严重。伯纳德被扶到附近林间空地休息，逐渐暖和起来并恢复体力。你们可以继续探索。但神秘飞行生物还会不会回来？

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 636
text: The cold blast did not hurt Bernard as badly as you feared. Helped to the shelter of a nearby glade, he warms up and recovers his strength. You can explore further. But can you risk the return of the mysterious flying being?
